michelle.p: Heads-up — updated handbook draft for 'Time Off & Leaves' is live: https://redwood.docs/internal/handbook/time-off-v3. Changes: parental leave wording, caregiver carveouts, and short-term unpaid leave process. Please review by EOD Wed and add any legal flags.

Kayla: Quick Q — do we still require manager approval before payroll cutoff for unpaid leave adjustments? The doc seems ambiguous.

michelle.p: Good catch — that line was changed. We want manager approval before payroll cutoff; I'll rephrase. If anyone on payroll/benefits wants to adjust, tag @harry.

harry: tagging in. For unpaid leave payroll adjustments, deadline is the 11th of the month at 11:59pm PT. If changes happen after that, they apply the next cycle. Can we add that exact deadline to the handbook?

michelle.p: yes, adding the payroll deadline. Also running a small pilot for compliance microtraining on the updated leave policies next week — 20-minute module + 10-min Q&A. Need ~12 volunteers to sanity-check wording and workflows. Sign-up: https://forms.redwood.com/leave-pilot (slots close in 48h).

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Volunteer slots left 7/12. Signup closes in 48h. :calendar:

Kayla: I can take a slot Tue 9am PT. Does it need manager approval to participate? (checking workload).

michelle.p: No manager approval needed; it's voluntary. We'll send a calendar invite which you can decline if it conflicts. Feedback will directly shape handbook final wording and FAQs.

tj: Please add an FAQ bullet for 'temporary remote work during leave' — several teams asked. Also include a short manager email template so folks know what to send.

michelle.p: Thanks — adding both. Draft manager template below, plz review and comment.

```
Subject: Team update — upcoming parental/caregiver leave
Hi team,

[Name] will be on leave from [start] to [end]. For urgent issues, please contact [backup].
We will cover knowledge transfer in the week before leave.

If you have questions about coverage or timelines, reply here or DM me.

Thanks,
[Manager Name]
```

legal-squad: Reviewed. A couple of suggestions: (1) add jurisdiction note for EU parental rights and statutory notice periods, (2) clarify PTO accrual treatment during unpaid leave; I'll drop inline comments in the doc (see the 'Legal' section).

michelle.p: Awesome — thanks everyone. If you've read the draft, react with :thumbsup: so I can track reviewers. I'll compile changes Friday afternoon; target to publish the handbook update and open the pilot cohort next Monday.

Kayla: :thumbsup:

harry: :thumbsup:

tj: :thumbsup:

michelle.p: Final note — if managers want to opt teams into the pilot (to guarantee coverage), DM me and we'll reserve slots. Cheers!
